name: Check Sky Light
description: An open-access civilian tool for augmented reality sky tracking, UAP anomaly analysis, and real-time airspace deconfliction. Point your camera at any unexplained aerial light or target to instantly cross-reference against live ADS-B flight transponders, NORAD satellite passes, weather balloons, and celestial bodies. Features Gemini AI optical analysis for photos and video, non-inertial kinematics evaluation, domestic luminaire filtering, and field-grade incident logging.
